52: @Provides(JavacASTVisitor.class)
53: @HandlerPriority(HANDLE_DELEGATE_PRIORITY + 100) // run slightly after HandleDelegate; resolution needs to work, so if the RHS expression is i.e. a call to a generated getter, we have to run after that getter has been generated.
54: @ResolutionResetNeeded
55: public class HandleVal extends JavacASTAdapter {
56: 	private JavacResolution resolution;
57: 	
58: 	private static boolean eq(String typeTreeToString, String key) {
59: 		return typeTreeToString.equals(key) || typeTreeToString.equals("lombok." + key) || typeTreeToString.equals("lombok.experimental." + key);
60: 	}
61: 	
62: 	@SuppressWarnings("deprecation") @Override
63: 	public void visitLocal(JavacNode localNode, JCVariableDecl local) {
64: 		JCTree typeTree = local.vartype;
65: 		if (typeTree == null) return;
66: 		String typeTreeToString = typeTree.toString();
67: 		JavacNode typeNode = localNode.getNodeFor(typeTree);
68: 		
69: 		if (!(eq(typeTreeToString, "val") || eq(typeTreeToString, "var"))) return;
70: 		boolean isVal = typeMatches(val.class, localNode, typeTree);
71: 		boolean isVar = typeMatches(var.class, localNode, typeTree);
72: 		if (!(isVal || isVar)) return;
73: 
74: 		if (isVal) handleFlagUsage(localNode, ConfigurationKeys.VAL_FLAG_USAGE, "val");
75: 		if (isVar) handleFlagUsage(localNode, ConfigurationKeys.VAR_FLAG_USAGE, "var");
76: 
77: 		JavacNode parentNode = localNode.directUp();
78: 		JCTree parentRaw = parentNode.get();
79: 		if (isVal && parentRaw instanceof JCForLoop) {
80: 			localNode.addError("'val' is not allowed in old-style for loops");
81: 			return;
82: 		}
83: 
84: 		if (parentRaw instanceof JCForLoop && ((JCForLoop) parentRaw).getInitializer().size() > 1) {
85: 			localNode.addError("'var' is not allowed in old-style for loops if there is more than 1 initializer");
86: 			return;
87: 		}
88: 
89: 		if (local.init == null && !(parentRaw instanceof JCEnhancedForLoop)) {
90: 			localNode.addError("'" + typeTreeToString + "' on a local variable requires an initializer expression");
91: 			return;
92: 		}
93: 
94: 		if (isVar && local.init instanceof JCLiteral && ((JCLiteral) local.init).value == null) {
95: 			if (local.init.type == null) {
96: 				localNode.addError("variable initializer is 'null'");
97: 			}
98: 		}
99: 
100: 		if (ifTypeIsIterableToComponent(localNode, local, typeNode, parentRaw, parentNode, isVal, typeTreeToString)) {
101: 			localNode.getAst().setChanged();
102: 		}
103: 	}
104: 
105: 	boolean ifTypeIsIterableToComponent(JavacNode localNode, JCVariableDecl local, JavacNode typeNode, JCTree parentRaw, JavacNode parentNode, boolean isVal, String annotation) {
106: 		JCExpression rhsOfEnhancedForLoop = null;
107: 		if (local.init == null && parentRaw instanceof JCEnhancedForLoop) {
108: 			JCEnhancedForLoop enhancedForLoop = (JCEnhancedForLoop) parentRaw;
109: 			if (enhancedForLoop.var == local) rhsOfEnhancedForLoop = enhancedForLoop.expr;
110: 		}
111: 
112: 		if (rhsOfEnhancedForLoop == null && local.init == null) {
113: 			localNode.addError("'" + annotation + "' on a local variable requires an initializer expression");
114: 			return false;
115: 		}
116: 
117: 		if (local.init instanceof JCNewArray && ((JCNewArray) local.init).elemtype == null) {
118: 			localNode.addError("'" + annotation + "' is not compatible with array initializer expressions. Use the full form (new int[] { ... } instead of just { ... })");
119: 			return false;
120: 		}
121: 
122: 		if (localNode.shouldDeleteLombokAnnotations()) {
123: 			JavacHandlerUtil.deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(localNode, val.class.getName());
124: 			JavacHandlerUtil.deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(localNode, lombok.experimental.var.class.getName());
125: 			JavacHandlerUtil.deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(localNode, var.class.getName());
126: 		}
127: 
128: 		if (isVal) local.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
129: 
130: 		if (!localNode.shouldDeleteLombokAnnotations()) {
131: 			JCAnnotation valAnnotation = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(localNode.getTreeMaker().Annotation(local.vartype, List.<JCExpression>nil()), typeNode);
132: 			local.mods.annotations = local.mods.annotations == null ? List.of(valAnnotation) : local.mods.annotations.append(valAnnotation);
133: 		}
134: 
135: 		if (JavacResolution.platformHasTargetTyping()) {
136: 			local.vartype = localNode.getTreeMaker().Ident(localNode.toName("___Lombok_VAL_Attrib__"));
137: 		} else {
138: 			local.vartype = JavacResolution.createJavaLangObject(localNode.getAst());
139: 		}
140: 
141: 		this.resolution = new JavacResolution(localNode.getContext());
142: 
143: 		Type type;
144: 		try {
145: 			if (rhsOfEnhancedForLoop == null) {
146: 				if (local.init.type == null) {
147: 					try {
148: 						type = ((JCExpression) this.resolution.resolveMethodMember(localNode).get(local.init)).type;
149: 					} catch (RuntimeException e) {
150: 						System.err.println("Exception while resolving: " + localNode + "(" + localNode.getFileName() + ")");
151: 						throw e;
152: 					}
153: 				} else {
154: 					type = local.init.type;
155: 					if (type.isErroneous()) {
156: 						try {
157: 							local.type = Symtab.instance(localNode.getContext()).unknownType;
158: 							type = ((JCExpression) this.resolution.resolveMethodMember(localNode).get(local.init)).type;
159: 						} catch (RuntimeException e) {
160: 							System.err.println("Exception while resolving: " + localNode + "(" + localNode.getFileName() + ")");
161: 							throw e;
162: 						}
163: 					}
164: 				}
165: 			} else {
166: 				if (rhsOfEnhancedForLoop.type == null) {
167: 					type = ((JCExpression) this.resolution.resolveMethodMember(parentNode).get(rhsOfEnhancedForLoop)).type;
168: 				} else {
169: 					type = rhsOfEnhancedForLoop.type;
170: 				}
171: 			}
172: 
173: 			try {
174: 				JCExpression replacement;
175: 
176: 				if (rhsOfEnhancedForLoop != null) {
177: 					Type componentType = null;
178: 					if (type != null) {
179: 						Types types = Types.instance(localNode.getContext());
180: 						Symtab symbols = Symtab.instance(localNode.getContext());
181: 						Type boundType = JavacResolution.typesUpperBound(types, type);
182: 						Type elemTypeIfArray = types.elemtype(boundType);
183: 						if (elemTypeIfArray != null) {
184: 							componentType = elemTypeIfArray;
185: 						} else {
186: 							Type base = types.asSuper(boundType, symbols.iterableType.tsym);
187: 							if (base == null) componentType = symbols.objectType;
188: 							else {
189: 								List<Type> iterableParams = base.allparams();
190: 								componentType = iterableParams.isEmpty() ? symbols.objectType : JavacResolution.typesUpperBound(types, iterableParams.head);
191: 							}
192: 						}
193: 					}
194: 					if (componentType == null) replacement = JavacResolution.createJavaLangObject(localNode.getAst());
195: 					else replacement = JavacResolution.typeToJCTree(componentType, localNode.getAst(), false);
196: 				} else {
197: 					replacement = JavacResolution.typeToJCTree(type, localNode.getAst(), false);
198: 				}
199: 
200: 				if (replacement != null) {
201: 					local.vartype = replacement;
202: 				} else {
203: 					local.vartype = JavacResolution.createJavaLangObject(localNode.getAst());
204: 				}
205: 				return true;
206: 			} catch (JavacResolution.TypeNotConvertibleException e) {
207: 				localNode.addError("Cannot use '" + annotation + "' here because initializer expression does not have a representable type: " + e.getMessage());
208: 				local.vartype = JavacResolution.createJavaLangObject(localNode.getAst());
209: 			}
210: 			return false;
211: 		} catch (RuntimeException e) {
212: 			local.vartype = JavacResolution.createJavaLangObject(localNode.getAst());
213: 			throw e;
214: 		} finally {
215: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(local.vartype, typeNode);
216: 		}
217: 	}
218: }
